newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak May M2 money +13.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Slovak May M2 money +13.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Slovak key M2 money aggregate grew by 13.4 percent year-on-year to the end of May, down from 14.6 percent in April, National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) Governor Vladimir Masar said on Wednesday.
"According to preliminary figures the M2 aggregate showed a slower increase in May when it rose 13.4 percent year-on-year," Masar told a forum of the country's leading business managers.
Year-on-year M2 growth in April was 14.6 percent.
